caveats: No regional MHW events were found under the specified definition: no sea cell reached a run of at least 5 consecutive hot days (hot = daily SST >= its smoothed 90th-percentile threshold, 1992-2002 baseline, +-5-day calendar-day-of-year windows) anywhere in 2004-06-01..2004-08-31; the longest hot run in any cell was 4 days. A broad regional warm spell (2004-08-07..2004-08-12, up to 1019 cells hot simultaneously on 2004-08-08) peaked just below the per-cell thresholds, which are inflated by the record Baltic warm spell of early August 2002 inside the baseline pool. The baseline range actually read spans the window extension days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 beyond the 1992-2002 baseline proper; day-of-year 60 (29 Feb) threshold and climatology were filled as the mean of days 59 and 61 and received no pool of their own. Dataset version 202506.
